description: The signed-in owner's own After Hours lines and pending setups. New lines use prepaid phone minutes or resolved conversations; existing per-call lines retain calls. Returns billing_mode, balance (seconds, outcomes, or legacy calls), minutes_remaining to one decimal for minute lines or outcomes_remaining for outcome lines, forwarding codes and recent_calls. Callers are shown by their last four digits only. Use it first to get the line_id that get_line_calls, get_line_messages, get_sip_address and buy_pack need. Needs lines:manage and changes nothing.
name: get_answering_line
title: The owner's answering lines: status, number, balance, recent calls
